summary.headline: Angelicus 17 Astrological Works
summary.text: Catalog entry for Angelicus 17, a 15th-century paper codex from the Passionei Library, listing medical and astrological materials on calendars, divination concerning travel and life or death, Pythagorean calculation, planetary stars, Chaldean and Egyptian astronomy, climacteric years, and lunar configurations. Authorities and cross-references include G. Muccio, Heliodorus, the Codices Mediolanensis and Vindobonensis, and Catalogus IV.
